intro.heading: Welcome to myNextDays.
intro.p1: A full property management system plus channel manager — for hotels, agencies and holiday rental hosts. Independent and fair, instead of corporate complexity and enterprise pricing.
intro.p2: Increase your occupancy, simplify daily work and create great guest experiences — without the complexity and the enterprise pricing of the big systems.
intro.p3: Everything in one place, smart automation and connections to every important channel — plus your own low-commission booking portal. Your business grows with more control and less effort.

zielgruppen.abschluss: Whatever the shape — it is all managed in the same system, with the same login.

hotel.text: Small hotels run their rooms as room types: every type carries its units, and the occupancy plan lists each room on its own — with arrival, departure and housekeeping. Booking.com, Expedia and the other booking portals receive the number of free units, not a yes/no. Prices, minimum stay and blocks are maintained once, and the channel manager distributes them to every connected portal. Invoice, payment and guest messaging live in the same system.
hotel.beleg: Availability as a number, not yes/no.

bnb.text: Breakfast, towels, pet fee, late arrival: extras stay attached to the booking and appear on the guest's invoice without a side calculation. If you run the B&B yourself, you don't want a second list — enquiries, messages, payments and availability come together in one place, on the desktop and on your phone. Card payments via Stripe are included, as is your own booking page without portal commission.

gaestehaus.unterzeile: Management for guest houses with several rooms
gaestehaus.text: Several units under one roof, one calendar: which guest gets which room stays your decision until arrival, without recreating the booking. The building decides what the portals see under one identifier; amenities, photos and prices are maintained per room type. Housekeeping tasks follow arrivals and departures and land on the team's phone — with their own login that shows tasks, not revenue.

motel.unterzeile: Software for motels and short stays
motel.text: High turnover, short stays, late arrivals: arrival details, access codes and the invoice reach the guest automatically — at the right moment and in their language, with 24 languages ready. Rooms that free up go back to every portal without a keystroke, and a stop-sell closes them everywhere at once. At the front desk the day plan is enough: who arrives, who leaves, what is still open.

lodge.unterzeile: Rent out a lodge, from your phone too
lodge.text: Remote does not mean cut off: prices, minimum stay, changeover days and blocks are managed on your phone exactly as at the desk — same calendar, same booking, no intermediate state. Seasonal rates are set in the rate grid for a whole year instead of typed day by day, and length-of-stay discounts reach the portals as well. Even without a reception, the guest knows how to get in.
lodge.beleg: On the road too, in the app.

ferienwohnung.text: One apartment, every channel: Booking.com, Airbnb, Vrbo, our own myBestDays marketplace and direct bookings on your website share a single calendar. Once a night is sold it is gone everywhere — double bookings cannot happen. Low-commission direct bookings can be favoured on purpose: your own pricing strategy, discounts for longer stays, automated messages from booking to departure, and card payments straight to your account.

resort.unterzeile: Manage a resort with many units
resort.text: Studios, suites and villas run as their own types with their own prices, amenities and occupancy rules — all under one account and one invoice. As many properties and as many units per type as you need, without anyone switching logins. Front desk, housekeeping and owners each see only their part; owner statements are produced per property including a report, instead of a spreadsheet at month's end.
resort.beleg: As many properties per account as you need.

huette.text: Seasonal operation without handwork: closed periods, changeover days, minimum and maximum stays are set once and apply on every portal at the same time. If the cabin is closed in winter, it is closed everywhere — no logging into five extranets. The changeover day stays free between two bookings so housekeeping has time, and arrival or departure days can be blocked individually.
huette.beleg: One block applies on every portal.

pension.unterzeile: Guesthouse administration with invoices and tourist tax
pension.text: Half board, tourist tax, regulars, payment on site: the system calculates surcharges and levies correctly for each portal — including where the portal reports a net amount and you need the gross price. Invoices, credit notes and open items sit in the same record as the booking, in your country's currency. Returning guests are recognised by their history instead of a search through old emails.

campingplatz.text: Pitches, rental caravans and glamping tents are types with a count: twenty identical pitches are one type with twenty units, not twenty calendars. Availability goes to the portals as a number so you never sell more than you have. Electricity, tourist tax or a dog are charged per night or per stay, and the day's arrivals are bundled in the day plan.
campingplatz.beleg: A count instead of twenty calendars.

faq.heading: The questions that come before switching systems.
faq.sub: What the platform does, what it costs and how your data is protected — without marketing speak.

was.antwort: myNextDays is a property management system and a channel manager in one — for hotels, guesthouses, holiday apartments, campsites and agencies. Calendar, reservations, prices, portals, direct bookings, guest messaging, housekeeping and billing sit in one interface with one login, instead of four tools that know nothing about each other.

portale.frage: Which booking portals can I connect?
portale.antwort: You reach 56 booking platforms, among them Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia, Vrbo, Google, Agoda and Tripadvisor. On top of that come our own myBestDays marketplace, a booking widget for your website and regional channels. Every channel is switched separately: you decide per property where it is visible.

sync.frage: How fast does it sync — and can double bookings happen?
sync.antwort: The sync runs both ways in real time: a booking on one portal blocks that night everywhere else, and changed prices or minimum stays go out immediately. All channels share one calendar, so no second truth appears. A stop-sell closes availability everywhere at once, not only where you set it.

betriebsarten.frage: Does it fit a hotel and holiday apartments at the same time?
betriebsarten.antwort: Yes, it is the same model: every property is exactly one type — a room type in a hotel or a holiday rental — and its units sit underneath. A hotel with eight double and four single rooms has two properties with eight and four units. The portals receive the number of free units, so five identical studios don't need five calendars.

direkt.frage: Do I get my own booking page without portal commission?
direkt.antwort: Yes. Every account includes its own booking portal, a widget for your existing website and a website builder with your own domain. Direct bookings cost 0.5 % instead of the 15–18 % commission of the large portals, run on the same calendar and the same prices — and the money goes straight to your account.

marktplatz.antwort: myBestDays is our own marketplace for guests — a booking channel on equal footing with Booking.com and Airbnb, only at a much lower commission. Properties you make visible there appear in the marketplace and in the myBestDays guest app. That visibility is its own switch, independent of the portals.

zahlungen.frage: How do payments, deposits and invoices work?
zahlungen.antwort: Online payments run through Stripe into your own account: deposit, balance or security deposit, by card and the payment methods Stripe offers in the guest's country. Invoices and credit notes come out of the booking, in the property's currency, with accounting-ready exports. Portal fees and levies are calculated correctly per portal — even where a portal only reports a net amount.

laender.frage: Which countries, currencies and languages does the platform cover?
laender.antwort: At launch on 1 September 2026 in 27 European countries. Interface and guest communication come in 24 languages; the guest reads the confirmation in their own language. Currency belongs to the property or the business — there is no euro assumption, kroner, złoty or forint are handled the same way.

rollen.frage: Who sees which data — owners, housekeeping, guests?
rollen.antwort: Every role has its own login and sees only its part. Owners see their properties, their occupancy and payouts, but nobody else's. Housekeeping sees tasks with photo checklists, not revenue. Guests have their own area with check-in, the digital guest guide and messages.

app.antwort: Two, because guests and operators need different things: the myNextDays app for the business, owners and housekeeping — calendar, bookings and tasks on the road — and the myBestDays app for guests with search, booking, check-in and messages. Both talk to the same system; nothing runs on a second copy.

sicherheit.frage: What about data protection and security?
sicherheit.antwort: Built in Denmark, hosted in the EU, GDPR-compliant including a data processing agreement. Each business's data is separated at database level, not just in the interface. Two-factor sign-in is available, role permissions limit access to financial and guest data, and every sign-in is traceable in the device history.

preis.frage: What does myNextDays cost and how do I start?
preis.antwort: 30 days free, no minimum term, no setup fee, cancel any time. After that a subscription plus a small commission on bookings we bring in. Add-on modules such as extended accounting with DATEV export, staff management or hotel functions are only added if you need them. Create a property, connect your channels, go.

faq.heading: Questions about price
faq.sub: What hosts want to know before switching — short and without small print.

laufzeit.antwort: No. The subscription runs monthly and can be cancelled with four weeks' notice to the end of the month. The first 30 days are free, with no payment details.

objektzahl.frage: What happens when I add properties?
objektzahl.antwort: You pay for the number of properties you booked. When one is added, the extra amount is charged pro rata and is usable immediately; the next tier applies automatically once you reach it.

waehrung.antwort: We bill in euros as the anchor currency; if you pay in another currency, checkout converts at the current rate. Your guests pay in your property's currency regardless.

steuern.frage: Are prices with or without tax?
steuern.antwort: All amounts shown are net. VAT depends on your country; with a valid VAT ID inside the EU we bill without tax (reverse charge).

umzug.frage: Can I bring my data with me?
umzug.antwort: Yes. Properties, rates and bookings can be imported, and the channels are reconnected. Our team helps with the setup — at no extra cost.

kuendigung.antwort: Your properties stay bookable until the end of the paid period. After that you still reach your data and can export it; nothing is deleted until you ask for it.

zahlungen.sub: Deposit on booking, balance before arrival, security deposit covered — collected automatically and documented in the booking.
zahlungen.bildAlt: Booking with payment status and receipts

a.text: Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal and local methods — the guest picks what they know.

b.text: You define once what is due when. Missing payments are visible before the guest arrives.

c.text: Invoices come from the booking, exports fit your accountant — no spreadsheets by hand.

eins.text: Every owner has their own login with occupancy, revenue and payouts. That saves the monthly email with a spreadsheet attached.

online.heading: Card, wallet, PayPal.
online.text: The guest pays with the method they know. The money goes to your account, the status sits in the booking.

plaene.heading: You decide what is due when.
plaene.text: Deposit, balance and security deposit follow your rules — different per property and channel if need be.

rechnungen.heading: From the booking, not from a spreadsheet.
rechnungen.text: Invoices and credit notes come from the real figures, with tax rate and number range. Exports fit your accountant.

eigentuemer.heading: Revenue, costs, payout.
eigentuemer.text: Every owner sees their properties with occupancy, revenue and payouts — as their own login instead of a monthly email.

preise.metaBeschreibung: Dynamic pricing with min./max., rate plans per property, season and occupancy logic — more revenue without daily handiwork.
preise.headline: Prices that look after themselves.
preise.sub: Season, occupancy, lead time and weekday feed in automatically. Your limits stay your limits: nothing goes below the minimum.
preise.bildAlt: Rate grid with dynamic prices per night

a.text: You set the frame, the system moves inside it — no price you did not want.

b.text: Non-refundable, early bird, long stay: several rates per property, each with its own rules.

c.text: A price you set by hand stays. Automation never overwrites a deliberate decision.

eins.titel: Discounts and surcharges go out to the channels too.
eins.text: Weekly and monthly discounts, early-bird promotions and surcharges are published where they are allowed — not only in your own view.

preise.bildAltBlock: Availability plan with prices per night

dynamisch.heading: Occupancy, season, lead time.
dynamisch.text: The price moves between your minimum and maximum — by demand, weekday and lead time, recalculated every night.

raten.heading: Several prices for the same property.
raten.text: Non-refundable, early bird, long stay: each rate with its own conditions — and each one goes out to the channels that support it.

rabatte.heading: Stay longer, pay less.
rabatte.text: Weekly and monthly discounts, promotions with a period, surcharges for short stays — visible right in the calendar.

grenzen.heading: Automation never has the last word.
grenzen.text: A price you set yourself stays. And nothing goes below your minimum — not even with an empty calendar.

team.metaBeschreibung: Roles for owners, housekeeping, staff and agencies — everyone sees only their area, with tasks and photo checklists.
team.headline: Everyone sees exactly what they need.
team.sub: Owners see their properties, housekeeping their jobs, staff their area. Finances stay where they belong.

a.text: Rights hang on the role, not on trust. A housekeeping login never reaches revenue.

b.text: Checklists with photos show that the flat was handed over — including the time.

c.text: After every departure the cleaning job appears by itself, with a deadline before the next arrival.

eins.titel: Agencies run several businesses side by side.
eins.text: Whoever rents out for others manages several owners in one account — with separate statements and their own logins.

rollen.heading: Everyone sees their own area.
rollen.text: Agency, owner, staff, housekeeping: rights hang on the role. Revenue is seen only by those who should see it.

aufgaben.heading: Cleaning appears by itself.
aufgaben.text: After every departure the task is in the plan, with a deadline before the next arrival. It is completed with a photo checklist.

eigentuemer.heading: Their own login instead of a monthly email.
eigentuemer.text: Owners see occupancy, revenue and payouts for their properties — read-only, with no way to interfere in the business.

agentur.heading: Several businesses in one account.
agentur.text: Whoever rents out for others runs several owners side by side — separate statements, separate logins, one calendar.

app.metaBeschreibung: Native app for the business, owners, guests and housekeeping — occupancy, tasks and messages on the go.
app.headline: Your business fits in your pocket.
app.sub: Check occupancy, create a booking, answer a message, tick off a task — from your phone, without a laptop.
app.bildAlt: Mobile app with occupancy and tasks

a.text: Owners, housekeeping and the business each have their own view — same app, different rights.

b.text: New booking, cancellation, guest question: you know at once, without opening the app.

c.text: Guests find the guest guide, check-in and messages in the myBestDays app.

eins.text: myNextDays runs the business, myBestDays belongs to the guest. Separate apps means no guest ever ends up in your figures.

app.bildAltBlock: Overview of the business at the desk

betrieb.heading: Occupancy and bookings under control.
betrieb.text: Check the calendar, create a booking, change a price — from your phone, on the same data as at the desk.

meldungen.heading: You know at once.
meldungen.text: A new booking, cancellation or guest question arrives as a notification — one tap and you are in the booking.

gast.heading: The myBestDays app.
gast.text: Guests find their booking, guest guide, check-in and messages in their own app — separate from yours.

rollen.heading: Housekeeping and owners.
rollen.text: Housekeepers see their jobs with a checklist, owners see their properties. Same app, different rights.

auswertungen.metaBeschreibung: Occupancy, revenue, ADR and channel comparison — reports that show why, not just what happened.
auswertungen.headline: Numbers you can decide on.
auswertungen.sub: Occupancy, revenue and average rate per property, period and channel — side by side instead of in five exports.

a.text: What does Booking bring in, what does your own site? Calculated with commission, not just by revenue.

b.text: Which property carries itself and which does not — visible in occupancy and average rate.

c.text: Monthly reports go out to you and your owners automatically, as a PDF in the familiar layout.

eins.titel: Past and outlook in one view.
eins.text: Next to what has been stands what is booked — so in February you can see whether the summer holds, instead of noticing it in July.

auswertungen.bildAltBlock: Hotel availability plan as the data behind it

auslastung.heading: How full is it really?
auslastung.text: Occupancy per property, month and channel — compared to last year, not as a gut feeling.

kanaele.heading: What does each channel bring in?
kanaele.text: Revenue after commission per channel: Booking, Airbnb, your own website, myBestDays — side by side instead of in five exports.

berichte.heading: They come by themselves.
berichte.text: Monthly reports go out to you and your owners automatically, as a PDF in the familiar layout.

ausblick.heading: What is already booked.
ausblick.text: Next to what has been stands the bookings on the books ahead — so in February you can see whether the summer holds.

meta.beschreibung: myNextDays ApS from Bindslev, Denmark: why working hosts built their own property management system with a channel manager, what we stand for and who is behind it.

hero.headlinePre: We rent out ourselves. That is why there is
hero.sub: myNextDays ApS is an owner-run company from Bindslev in northern Jutland. We rent out our own holiday properties — and built the platform we were missing every day: calendar, channels, guests, payments and accounting in one place.

warum.heading: Born out of running our own rentals.
warum.p1: Anyone who rents out knows the evening when the same week has been sold twice because one channel never received the block. That is where we stopped looking for a tool and started building one.
warum.p2: The existing systems were either made for hotel chains — with a complexity and a price no business with a handful of properties can carry — or they stopped exactly where the real work begins: accounting, owners, cleaning and taxes across 27 countries.
warum.p3: myNextDays is the answer to that: a complete property management system with a channel manager, for businesses that run their properties themselves — from a single holiday home to a hotel with several room types.
warum.bildHotel: Hotel room with a made bed

bento.heading: Numbers we can prove.
bento.sub: No customer counts and no review scores: the platform launches on 1 September 2026. What is listed here can be checked in the product itself.

vermieter.titel: Built by hosts, not on a drawing board
vermieter.text: Every feature runs in our own rental business before it reaches the product. What does not hold up there in daily use is not shipped.
vermieter.bildAlt: Team of a rental agency at work

laender.text: With the currency, the tax rates and the rules of each country — not one euro form for everyone.

sprachen.text: Interface, guest communication and legal texts, not just the landing page.

kanaele.text: Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia, Vrbo and many more through one connection.

eu.titel: Built in the EU, operated in the EU
eu.text: Servers and data sit in the European Union, operations follow the GDPR, and data processing is covered by a written agreement. For a business handling guest data that is not a footnote but a precondition.

zeitleiste.heading: Short history, verifiable steps.
zeitleiste.sub: We are young — and would rather list four documented stages than invent a history.

airsmil.titel: Daily life in our own business
airsmil.text: Our own holiday properties on several channels at once: duplicate work, blocks arriving late, accounting in a spreadsheet. Those frictions became the requirements list.

gruendung.text: Registered in the Danish business register under CVR no. 46615182, with its seat in Bindslev, northern Jutland.

beta.text: Bookings arrive live from the channels, prices, availability and blocks travel the same way back — with real properties and real guests, not in a test environment.

start.text: In 24 languages, with multi-currency, the myBestDays marketplace and the two apps for the business and the guest.

marken.heading: myNextDays for the business, myBestDays for the guest.
marken.sub: Both belong to myNextDays ApS and run on the same technology — what separates them is who uses them.

nextdays.text: The property management system and the channel manager: the place where a business runs its properties, sets its prices and settles its money.

punkte.kalender: Occupancy plan across all properties and units, in real time
punkte.portale: One connection for every channel — availability, prices and blocks go everywhere at once
punkte.geld: Payments, invoices, commissions and owner statements
punkte.team: Dedicated app for owners, staff and cleaning

bestdays.text: Our own marketplace: guests find the same properties there and book directly with the business — at a far lower commission than through the large channels.

punkte.direkt: Booking directly with the business, no middleman
punkte.provision: Lower commission than on the large channels
punkte.app: Dedicated app for search, booking and the stay

marken.hinweis: A property is sold through both routes at the same time — plus Booking.com, Airbnb and the other channels. Which channel is switched on is decided by the business, channel by channel.

werte.heading: What we want to be measured by.
werte.sub: Six points you can check in the product and in our documents — not statements of intent.

doppelbuchung.text: With us availability is a number of free units, not a checkbox. It reaches every channel in real time, and a block blocks everywhere — not only where it was entered.

preise.text: One plan, no minimum term, no setup fee. Whatever costs extra is listed with its amount on the pricing page, not revealed in a sales call.

europa.titel: Europe is not a translation project
europa.text: 27 countries means 27 currencies, tax rates and reporting duties — down to the invoice, the guest email and the payout. Where a value is missing, we say so instead of filling in something plausible.

daten.text: Operations and servers in the European Union, the GDPR as the basis, a data processing agreement as standard. Inside a business, guest data is visible only to the roles that need it.

unabhaengig.text: No corporation behind us and no roadmap imposed from outside. What gets built next is decided together with the businesses that use the software every day.

selbst.text: Our own properties run on the same platform as those of our customers. A bug hits us first — the most honest quality assurance we know.

menschen.heading: Small, reachable, from practice.
menschen.sub: The management of myNextDays ApS as registered in the Danish business register.

jeanine.text: Runs our own rental business and brings the daily reality of guests, channels and cleaning into every product decision.

torsten.text: Keeps all the threads together and supports the team exactly where it is needed. Brings his versatile hands-on experience to find fast, pragmatic solutions behind the scenes.

unternehmen.heading: Who you are dealing with.
unternehmen.impressum: Full provider details in the legal notice
unternehmen.kontaktText: Questions about the product, about switching from another system or about working together? The person answering uses the software themselves.

meta.beschreibung: How to reach myNextDays: general questions and sales at {info}, technical enquiries at {technik}, by phone on {telefon} — or straight through the form.

hero.sub: Questions about the product, about switching from another system, about connecting via our API or about working together: pick your topic and the message goes straight to the people who know it.

wege.heading: Who handles your enquiry?
wege.sub: Two inboxes and a chat. Commercial matters and everything before you start go to the general inbox, everything technical straight to the development team — so nothing ends up in a queue nobody looks at.

allgemein.text: Want to know whether myNextDays fits your business, what switching from another system involves, or how invoicing and subscriptions work? This is the right way in — for press, partnerships and data-protection requests too.

technik.text: Something isn't working, a channel connection is stuck, you're building against our API or you've found a security flaw? These enquiries go straight to the development team, not via sales.

hilfe.text: Step-by-step guides for every area are in the Help Centre. And if it needs to be quick: there's a chat in the bottom right of every page where a real person answers — no account, no sign-in.
hilfe.chatHinweis: Chat in the bottom right of every page

formular.heading: Write to us
formular.sub: One form for everything — your topic decides who receives it.

eingang.text: Through our own mail server in Denmark — no third-party form service with your details passing through its hands.

zuordnung.titel: It lands in the right inbox
zuordnung.text: Commercial matters at {info}, technical ones at {technik}. Which one it is, our server decides from your topic.

antwort.text: As an ordinary email to the address you enter here — you can simply reply to it.

formular.hinweisPostfach: Two inboxes so nothing is left sitting: {info} for everything commercial, {technik} for everything technical. Which one it becomes is decided by our server from your topic — this form cannot name a destination.
formular.name: Name
formular.nachrichtPlatzhalter: Describe your enquiry — the more precise, the better the answer fits.
formular.fehlerAllgemein: That didn't work. Please try again later.
formular.fehlerPruefung: The security check didn't pass. Please reload the page and send your message again.
formular.fehlerFelder: Please check your details: name, email and a message of at least 20 characters are required.
formular.fehlerZuOft: Too many messages have come from this connection. Please wait a moment and try again.
formular.fehlerSpaeter: The message can't be delivered right now. Please try again later or write directly to {email}.
formular.datenschutzHinweis: We use your details only to answer this enquiry. More in our <link>privacy policy</link>.
formular.recaptchaHinweis: This form is protected by reCAPTCHA. Google's <datenschutz>Privacy Policy</datenschutz> and <bedingungen>Terms of Service</bedingungen> apply.

anschrift.heading: How to reach us directly
anschrift.firmaText: Nobody should have to hunt through the small print to find out who the contracting party is. That's why the register details are right here — the same ones as in the imprint.

faq.heading: Questions about getting in touch
faq.sub: Who answers, how long it takes and what happens to your details.

wer.antwort: A person from the team, not a ticket system with a number. myNextDays is owner-run: commercial questions are answered by someone who uses the software daily, technical ones by the development team.

postfach.frage: How do I know where my message lands?
postfach.antwort: The destination address is shown under the topic field for every enquiry. General, commercial and editorial matters go to {info}; technical enquiries, API questions and security reports to {technik}. Our server makes the assignment — the form cannot name an inbox, so it can't be abused as a way of sending messages to strangers.

sprache.frage: Which language can I write in?
sprache.antwort: Write in the language you're reading this page in — we see it in your enquiry and answer in it as far as we can. German, Danish and English we always answer.

dauer.frage: How long does an answer take?
dauer.antwort: Usually within a few hours; at weekends and on public holidays it can take longer. For security reports: they sit with the development team without any detour through sales.

telefon.antwort: Yes, on {telefon}. A call is the fastest route for anything better discussed than written — for technical faults a message is often still better, because you can attach error messages and screenshots.

bestaetigung.frage: Do I get an email confirming receipt?
bestaetigung.antwort: No, deliberately not. An automatic confirmation would go to whatever address is typed in here — which would let someone use our mail server to write to other people's inboxes. So the confirmation appears here on the page as soon as the message has arrived. We use your details solely to answer this enquiry.
